problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a single vehicle to perform a round-trip inspection of 10 regional warehouses.  
The geographical positions of the warehouses are fixed:  
Warehouse Alpha: (193,172)  
Warehouse Beta: (50,152)  
Warehouse Gamma: (21,9)  
Warehouse Delta: (18,67)  
Warehouse Epsilon: (78,136)  
Warehouse Zeta: (87,30)  
Warehouse Eta: (135,63)  
Warehouse Theta: (195,41)  
Warehouse Iota: (17,106)  
Warehouse Kappa: (74,72)  

Travel distances between warehouses, expressed in kilometers, are predetermined:  
Alpha to Gamma: 237.0 km  
Alpha to Delta: 204.1 km  
Alpha to Epsilon: 120.5 km  
Alpha to Zeta: 177.2 km  
Alpha to Eta: 123.5 km  
Alpha to Theta: 131.0 km  
Alpha to Iota: 188.0 km  
Alpha to Kappa: 155.4 km  
Beta to Gamma: 145.9 km  
Beta to Delta: 90.8 km  
Beta to Epsilon: 32.2 km  
Beta to Zeta: 127.5 km  
Beta to Eta: 123.1 km  
Beta to Theta: 182.6 km  
Beta to Iota: 56.6 km  
Beta to Kappa: 83.5 km  
Gamma to Delta: 58.1 km  
Gamma to Epsilon: 139.2 km  
Gamma to Zeta: 69.3 km  
Gamma to Eta: 126.1 km  
Gamma to Theta: 176.9 km  
Gamma to Iota: 97.1 km  
Gamma to Kappa: 82.3 km  
Delta to Epsilon: 91.4 km  
Delta to Zeta: 78.3 km  
Delta to Eta: 117.1 km  
Delta to Theta: 178.9 km  
Delta to Iota: 39.0 km  
Delta to Kappa: 56.2 km  
Epsilon to Zeta: 106.4 km  
Epsilon to Eta: 92.6 km  
Epsilon to Theta: 150.7 km  
Epsilon to Iota: 68.0 km  
Epsilon to Kappa: 64.1 km  
Zeta to Eta: 58.2 km  
Zeta to Theta: 108.6 km  
Zeta to Iota: 103.3 km  
Zeta to Kappa: 44.0 km  
Eta to Theta: 63.9 km  
Eta to Iota: 125.6 km  
Eta to Kappa: 61.7 km  
Theta to Iota: 189.5 km  
Theta to Kappa: 124.9 km  
Iota to Kappa: 66.4 km  

Due to a permanent closure, no direct route exists between Warehouse Alpha and Warehouse Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to conflicting maintenance schedules, exactly one of two specific connections must be part of the inspection circuit: either the link between Warehouse Beta and Warehouse Gamma, or the link between Warehouse Gamma and Warehouse Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed tour that visits every warehouse precisely once before returning to the initial point of departure.
